summary: Grant Parish, LA: CCC-built 100' tower (1936), run by Forest Service from 1942; moved to a Bentley tourist attraction in 1993. No source describes it today.

facts.design: 100' Aermotor steel tower with LS-40 7'x7' cab
facts.status_note: Moved in 1993 to a Bentley tourist attraction, per the Forest Lookouts site; no source we read describes the tower there today.

staffing.status: run by CCC crews until 1942, then by Forest Service personnel

events.note: Built by the CCC, per the register description
CCC operation ended; Forest Service personnel took over
Placed under a special use permit held by the Louisiana State Forestry Department; ran as a cooperative tower with the Forest Service
Moved to a Bentley tourist attraction, per the Forest Lookouts site
Registered February 24, 2011 as US 856, LA 3, nominated by Mark H. Gutzman

evidence.supports: built in 1936 by the CCC; 100-foot Aermotor steel tower with LS-40 7x7 cab
evidence.quote: Built in 1936 by the CCC, this 100’ Aermotor steel tower with LS-40 7’x7’ cab

evidence.supports: CCC operation until 1942, then Forest Service personnel took over
evidence.quote: operated by the CCC until 1942 when U.S. Forest Service personnel took over

evidence.supports: 1983 special use permit held by Louisiana State Forestry Department; operated as a Coop (cooperative) tower with the Forest Service
evidence.quote: In 1983 the tower was put under a Special Use Permit by the Louisiana State Forestry Department, and was operated as a Coop tower with the US Forest Service
In 1988, the tower was purchased by a Mr. Thorne

evidence.supports: register places the tower in Kisatchie National Forest
administered by the U.S. Forest Service
moved in 1993 to a Bentley tourist attraction
evidence.quote: 1993: Moved to a Bentley tourist attraction.

sources.title: Colfax Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites Register
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites Register (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: The 1993 move to a Bentley tourist attraction rests on one line on the Forest Lookouts site. A Facebook group post titled 'Fire Tower in Bentley' turned up in search, but it could not be read, so we have not confirmed it is this tower. The 1936 build date, 1942 handover and 1983 permit come from the register description only. Nothing we read describes the attraction, the tower's condition or any visitor access, so access is left out of the facts.
